args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail since `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212.
- Changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent ties round to the even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on this branch passed (including `tests/test_money.py`).
